name: Golden Customers
description: Some sort-column slots are golden customers. Filling a golden slot pays out coins that fly into a coin bag, with juicy Mario-style SFX and a fanfare on each mini-completion.
howToPlay: Tap revealed boxes to send marbles down the funnel onto the belt. Marbles auto-sort into their matching columns. Watch for the shimmering golden slots — every marble that lands on a golden slot mints coins that fly into the coin bag with a satisfying clatter. Clear all columns to win.
author: Eduardo Ribeiro

showcaseLevel.name: Golden Customer
showcaseLevel.desc: Level to showplay the golden customer mechanic.
